ModMetaData.name: Alpha Genes - Germline Mutator Blacklist
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Choose which genes Alpha Genes' germline mutator is never allowed to give.
The germline mutator adds one random gene to a pawn, picked from almost every loaded gene. With a lot of gene mods that includes genes that make no sense as a random mutation: android parts, astrogenes, sleeve quality genes and the like. With this mod a default list of those is blocked, and so is everything on Alpha Genes' own wretch blacklist.
Every gene the mutator could pick is listed in the mod settings with a search box and a tick box per gene, so you can block more or allow ones the defaults block. Changes apply straight away; no restart needed.
The default list is an XML def (GermlineMutatorBlacklist.GermlineBlacklistDef), so other mods can add their own list or patch this one.
Originally part of Too Many Mods - Compats and Rebalances by Warachia.
